metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for engineering work done as planned, proven steps: audits that check what a codebase claims against what it does, plans a cheaper model can build from, and build loops in which nothing is merged on a report alone.

plugins.name: rebuild-factory
plugins.description: Audit, plan and rebuild an existing codebase with a builder whose reports are never taken on trust. Five stages, each a skill that writes into one plan folder: a red-team and claims-versus-code audit with numbered findings; the owner's direction; a plan with requirement ids, small sessions, plan-owned fixtures, one phase command and mutation checks; an independent plan review; and a conductor loop that starts a separate coding agent per session through a bundled bridge, reviews its work from a clean clone by breaking things on purpose, merges on a pass and sends findings back on a fail. Ships five agents, a helper script, templates, and the OpenCode bridge as an MCP server. Parameterised per project by a config file; nothing in it is specific to one product.

plugins.name: transcribe
plugins.description: Turn a local audio or video file, or a URL, into a text transcript, processed on your own machine with faster-whisper. No API key, and the audio is not sent to any speech service. Timestamped lines, plain text or SubRip subtitles.

plugins.name: expertise-miner
plugins.description: Pull the transcripts of a YouTube channel, playlist or video into a searchable local corpus, then mine them for an expert's research questions, rules of thumb and research steps. Every mined item carries a quote checked word for word against the stored transcript, the video, the timestamp and a way to test it against data. Slow and polite by default; SQLite storage, with MongoDB and a proxy as optional settings. Ships an MCP server, three skills and a file-only reader agent.
